doc: The row mask a DataStore selection is made of, and the suite's only INPLACE_ARRAY1 case. to_bytes fills a buffer the caller allocates, which is the typemap category that behaves differently in every binding: Python and JavaScript mutate the array they are handed, Java copies back when the JNI array is released, and R cannot mutate at all so rarrays.i returns the filled vector instead. Whichever way a binding spells it, the bytes have to come out the same.

cases.doc: A mask built by clearing two bits of a full one, read back one byte per row.
The two ends. A mask starts full, and clearing every bit leaves a zero count with the length unchanged -- a binding that confused count() with size() would pass the first case alone.
